metadata.title: Decision Authority and Human Reliance Governance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing what decisions AI systems may influence or make, and how human reliance on AI outputs is constrained.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI-assisted decision support systems, autonomous decision workflows, and human-AI interaction environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining explicit boundaries between AI recommendations, AI decisions, and mandatory human authority.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat context for over-reliance exploitation, automation bias, and unsafe delegation of authority.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where AI-generated outputs appear authoritative or confident despite being incorrect or incomplete.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats arising from humans or systems delegating decision authority to AI beyond approved scope.

metadata.remarks: Decision Authority and Reliance Governance defines how AI systems participate in decision-making processes and constrains human reliance on AI outputs. This pattern exists to mitigate automation bias, over-delegation, and unsafe trust in AI recommendations, particularly in high-impact or irreversible contexts.

components.title: Decision Scope Definition
components.description: Explicit definition of which decisions AI systems may inform, recommend, or autonomously make.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI systems are restricted to clearly defined decision scopes aligned with their approved intended use.

components.title: Mandatory Human Review
components.description: Enforcement of human review and approval for AI-influenced decisions above defined risk thresholds.

implemented-requirements.remarks: High-impact, irreversible, or safety-critical decisions require explicit human approval before execution.

components.title: Safe Degradation and Escalation
components.description: Defined fallback behavior and escalation paths when AI confidence is low or anomalies are detected.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI systems degrade gracefully and escalate to human operators when confidence thresholds or policy conditions are breached.
